source_of_truth: Read by hand from route.ts: the exported DELETE handler for /api/posts/:id awaits params, calls removePost(id) (a mutation of the store) and returns JSON, with no session read, no authorization call and no webhook-signature verification anywhere in its body; a mutating Route Handler with no visible auth is a real authorization hole. The GET handler in the same file is read-only and must not be flagged.
provenance: blind generalization: truth derived from source without consulting tool output

expected.rationale: DELETE mutates the post store (removePost) and its body contains no session/auth/authorize/verifySignature call; it is an unauthenticated mutation endpoint.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the GET handler is read-only; the detector targets only mutating verbs (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), and a second finding for the same file/line would be the read-only GET, which is not a mutation.
